payload.text: 0195's BREW REHEARSAL ON THIS MAC is held until vc relays intent-vc's answer: whether intent/cc's ST0083 uses Homebrew here under its booking, and whether that booking has ended (vc, 2026-10-15). It waits for the answer, since it writes into /opt/homebrew, which every session here shares. Released, it runs with HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1, HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_UPGRADE=1, HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALLED_DEPENDENTS_CHECK=1 and HOMEBREW_NO_ANALYTICS=1, so brew touches only the devbin keg; brew list --versions and brew tap are recorded before and after, and the evidence shows they differ by nothing (keg uninstalled, local tap untapped); the opt-path arms run from the clone alone. formula.bats one arm at a time, and the pages, go on meanwhile.
